import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    df = inputs["rate_feed"].copy()

    # Replicate cursor ORDER BY account_id, obs_date, obs_seq
    df_sorted = df.sort_values(
        by=["account_id", "obs_date", "obs_seq"],
        kind="mergesort"
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    # Forward-fill rate within each account_id group (carry never crosses accounts)
    df_sorted["rate_filled"] = df_sorted.groupby("account_id")["rate"].ffill()

    # was_carried = 1 when original rate was NULL but a prior rate existed to carry forward
    was_carried = df_sorted["rate"].isna() & df_sorted["rate_filled"].notna()
    df_sorted["was_carried"] = was_carried.astype("int64")

    result = df_sorted[["account_id", "obs_seq", "obs_date", "rate_filled", "was_carried"]].copy()

    return {"rate_filled": result}
